rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the supply-side nature of the current food price spike, we cannot afford to be complacent. With headline CPI at 7.44% and a positive output gap of 0.60%, the risk of these shocks becoming generalized and unanchoring inflation expectations is significant. The credibility of our 4.00% target depends on our willingness to signal that we will not tolerate prolonged deviations from the tolerance band. I agree with Deputy Governor Patra that liquidity management of the 120,000 crore surplus is crucial, but I believe maintaining the current repo rate while strictly adhering to the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance provides the necessary discipline to ensure durable disinflation without prematurely stifling the 7.80% GVA growth momentum.
